Product Features

  • Flexible configuration for social gatherings: This furniture set consists of a two-seater sofa, two armchairs, two stools and a removable table. The furniture can be flexibly combined for different outdoor areas.
  • Removable table: The table is removable and can be flexibly combined or used separately depending on the space required and use.
  • Sturdy iron frame construction: The sofa, armchair and table have a sturdy iron frame that provides stability and a secure hold - ideal for terraces and balconies.
  • Braided armrests: The armrests are finished with rope mesh, which makes them visually and haptically appealing and combines functionality with design.
  • Thick cushions for long-lasting comfort: The set includes thick cushions that provide excellent support - perfect for relaxing, lively conversations or relaxed reading.

Descriptions

Description

This modern, minimalist garden furniture set with table and chairs is ideal for terraces, balconies and semi-open outdoor areas. The table is removable and can be flexibly combined or set up individually to make optimal use of the space. The robust iron construction with rope armrests and a thick seat cushion guarantees durability and high seating comfort. Thanks to the flexible arrangement of the table and chairs, this set is suitable for both relaxing hours in everyday life and social gatherings with guests, transforming your garden into a cozy outdoor living room in no time at all.
